text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-wh-whoa?! I got first place... me! Is that even possible?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
This h-has to be a dream, there's no way.
Let me
pinch my cheeks to check!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
O-okay, that really hurt... Th-that means
this has
to be a prank?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Someone'll show up any second now to
announce
the real winner... won't they?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: It's too early to get carried away.

text_block_list.text: Oh wow... I got first... place. Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes hard work really does pay
off. I'm so
happy, e-even if this is j-just a
fluke.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
W-wait, I hope this won't come back to
bite me
later on... I'm not being lied to,
right?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, y-you're right about that! This must
be how it
f-f-feels to be on cloud nine...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Let's just make sure we stay on track!

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! There's still more to come... I
nearly
forgot!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'll train more, and do well in my studies,
and...
once I'm done with that...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото's anxieties last the rest of
the day,
despite my efforts to quell
them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hopefully in the next race, I won't do
too
bad—no, I'm going to win again! I'll
g-give this
everything I've got!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
